content: Nuuni Kiristoosan Issino
Hiza, Godaa gisho qashetida taani, hinte xeegetida xeessas bessiya de7o daana mela hintena woossayis.
Hinte ubba wode aadatanne hayo gidite; issoy issuwa danda7itenne siiqon de7ite.
Sarotethan qashetidi Ayyaanay immiya issifetetha naaganaw minnite.
Xoossay hintena xeegida wode issi ufaysas xeegidaysada issi asatethinne issi Ayyaani de7ees.
Issi Goday, issi ammanoynne issi xinqatey de7ees.
Ubbaafe bolla gidida, ubbaa baggara oothiyanne ubbaa giddon de7iya issi Xoossay, ubbaa Aaway de7ees.
Shin Kiristoosi immanaw koydaysada nu issoy issoy dumma dumma imota ekida.
Hessa gisho, Xoossaa qaalay,
yaagees.
Yaatin, “Pude keyis” guussay woy guussee? I koyro duge, sa7aa ziqa bessaa wodhis guussu gidonna ixiko ay guussee?
Ha duge wodhidaysi, ubba bessan bentanaw ubbaafe dhoqa saluwa keydaysi iya.
I issota issota hawaareta, issota issota nabeta, issota issota Wongela sabaaketa, issota issota woosa keethi heemmeyisata, issota issota astamaareta oothidi immis.
I hessa oothiday Kiristoosa asatethi gidida woosa keethi dichanawunne ammaniya asaa Xoossaa oosos giigisanaasa.
Hessadaka, nu ubbay Xoossaa Na7aa eridi ammanon bentiya issifetethaako gakidi, Kiristoosa ayyaana de7uwa kumethi gakidi diccana melasa.
Hizape guye, asaa gene cimon giigida balethiya wordo timirte carkoninne hobben gedenne haa kuullo kaa7iya nayta mela gidanaw bessenna.
Shin nuuni tumaa siiqon odishe, asatethaas huuphe gidiya Kiristoosara de7iya issifetetha guji guji dichoos.
Kumetha asatethay Kiristoosa bolla zempees qassi dumma dumma asatethaa billiteti issoy issuwara oyketidi uttis. Issi issi asatethaa kifiley ba oosuwa oothiya wode kumetha asatethay siiqon diccees.
Gal7a De7onne Ooratha De7o
Hessa gisho, taani haysa hintew Godaa sunthan odaysinne markatayis. Go77i bayna qofaa qopiya Ayhude gidonna asatada de7opite.
Enta qofay dhumis; banta wozanaa muumisidosona. Enti eratetha dhayoninne ixas gidi Xoossay immiya de7uwape haakidosona.
Enti yeella giyaba erokona; enti laymatethas bantana aathidi immidosona; qassi tunabaa ubbaa guye goonna oothosona.
Shin hinte Kiristoosa eriday hessa mela ogen gidenna.
Iyabaa tuma si7ideta. Qassi Yesuusan de7iya tumaa mela iyape tamaarideta.
Hinte kase de7ida de7o ogiya aggite. Qassi ba cimmiya amon dhayiya hinte ceega asatethaa diggite.
Hinte wozanaa qofan ooraxite.
Tuma xillotethaninne geeshshatethan Xoossaa leemison medhetida ooratha asatethaa ma7ite.
Hiza, wordo odetofite. Nuuni ubbay Kiristoosa asatethaa billiteta gidiya gisho asa ubbaara tuma odetite.
Hanqetite, shin hinte hanquwan nagara oothopite. Hinte hanqeti de7ishin awi wullofo.
Xalahes besse immofite.
Kaysotiya uray hizape guye kaysotopo. Shin manqota maaddiyabay iyaw daana mela ba kushen lo77oba ootho.
Hinte doonape iita qaali keyopo. Shin si7eyisata go77ana melanne harata minthethiya koshshiya lo77o qaali hinte doonape keyo.
Xoossay hintena woziya gallasas hintena attamidi wothida Xoossaa Ayyaana azzanthofite.
Cametethi, yilo, hanqo, waaso, cashshenne iita ubbaa hintefe haassite.
Aathidi issoy issuwas keehanne qadheteyisata gidite. Xoossay Kiristoosa baggara hintew atto gidaysada hinteka wolis atto giite.
